title: Comprehension
description: Understand the passage’s claims, logic, scope and implications.
approach: Read for claim, evidence, qualifiers and scope. Reject options that go beyond the passage.

title: Arithmetic & Basic Numeracy
description: Quantitative questions based on numerical relationships and elementary mathematics.
approach: Repair arithmetic foundations, then practise short timed sets and record calculation errors.

title: Algebra
description: Translate relationships into symbolic expressions and solve systematically.
approach: Write the relationship first, solve cleanly, and check whether the result satisfies constraints.

title: Geometry & Mensuration
description: Spatial reasoning and measurement using properties, diagrams and formulae.
approach: Draw a labelled figure and memorise formulas through derivation and retrieval.

title: Counting & Probability
description: Count possible outcomes and reason about likelihood without double counting.
approach: Define the sample space; identify order/repetition; test small cases if valid.

title: Data Interpretation
description: Extract quantities from tables and charts, then compare, aggregate or calculate.
approach: Read units and totals before calculating; estimate first and preserve units.

title: Logical Reasoning & Analytical Ability
description: Deduction, constraints, relationships and validity of conclusions.
approach: Translate statements exactly, diagram only when useful, and separate possibility from certainty.

title: Decision-making & Problem-solving
description: Choose defensible actions under conditions, constraints and given facts.
approach: Use only the information given and respect the exam’s specific instructions.

title: Other / Mixed aptitude
description: A controlled category for verified tasks that do not fit a listed family cleanly.
approach: Do not classify based on a formula that happens to solve the question; classify by the actual task.
